integrity: Branch-cycle constructions and signed-permutation group proofs are supplied. Finite exact tests are supplementary, not infinite proofs.
scientific_limitations: Valid for complex polynomial maps with the stated three-finite-branch-value passport. Uses the earlier complete braid-orbit classification. No arithmetic-monodromy or deformation assertions. No independent priority certification.
title: A monodromy-group trichotomy for sparse polynomial covers with two paired simple branch values
